rng_substitution.falsifier: two distinct proptest executions share every field in proofbound-sampling-contract/1 because RNG algorithm is absent

rejected_workarounds: treat all predicate invocations as fresh attempts
infer accepted shrink count from call order

decisions.q1: fail: RNG algorithm is execution-relevant and independently configurable under the same proptest version and seed, but proofbound-sampling-contract/1 cannot represent it
decisions.q2: fail: the stable typed API does not expose the counters needed to partition predicate invocations into fresh successes, rejections, and shrink replays
decisions.q3: fail: TestError retains a typed minimal counterexample, but an authoritative accepted-shrink count is unavailable without private or prose interfaces
decisions.q4: reject the unchanged common execution contract; do not add a Rust-only escape hatch

attack_execution.reason: Q1, Q2, and Q3 had already triggered their preregistered falsifiers; completing a rejection matrix could not turn the unchanged contract into a pass

design_consequence.common_layer: retain evidence-family meaning, generator closure, target inventory, requested successful budget, seed value, persistence posture, and empirical ceiling
design_consequence.backend_plan: bind typed framework-specific execution controls such as RNG algorithm, rejection ceilings, phases, and shrink limits
design_consequence.observation_capability: represent exactly which counters the backend can authoritatively observe; never fill absent counters by inference
design_consequence.next_step: prototype a layered SamplingIntent + BackendSamplingPlan + capability-indexed SamplingObservation and replay the three-framework corpus

production_status: research-only; existing portable receipts and production schemas remain unchanged
